captions.detailed: This 3D model is a tall parametric spur gear with a cylindrical body and a central shaft hole. The gear features twelve straight, rounded teeth running vertically along its outer circumference. The central bore is circular but includes a flat 'D-cut' section on one side of the inner wall, designed to prevent shaft slippage.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric spur gear in OpenSCAD with adjustable parameters for the number of teeth, gear diameter, gear height, and shaft diameter. Include options to add top and bottom flanges, adjust tooth shape resolution, and toggle a D-cut flat section inside the central bore.
captions.factory: The design uses a main module 'pgear' which combines a central gear cylinder and optional flange cylinders using a union. A difference operation subtracts a central shaft cylinder and a series of rotated cylinders in a for-loop to define the gear gaps. Another loop adds the gear teeth using rotated cylinders, and a final conditional block uses a cube to subtract material from the inner bore to create the D-cut shaft profile.
